pages.scan: Opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-01.png with Read. It loaded and I viewed it before reading anything else. The request JSON was read first only to get the image path. The runtime did not give me a task identity, so task is left null. Layout: one wide top panel, then a tall left panel and a tall right panel below it.
pages.observation: How I read it: (1) Top panel: the caption 'A busy day at Dr. Ananya's clinic.' at top left, then the small ananya box at upper centre. This panel has no dialogue. (2) Lower-left panel: the balloon 'Appointments, patient details, follow-ups...' at top left, then 'I wish everything were easier to manage!' to its right and lower. Both tails go to the meera box, so I read them as one speaker continuing. That was natural. (3) Lower-right panel: 'Our time belongs with patients. Let's make the rest simpler.' with a tail to ananya at the right. A small meera box sits lower left, which reads as Meera listening. Issues: Meera speaks first but is never introduced. From the image alone I cannot tell her role (receptionist? staff?) or how she relates to Dr. Ananya. Ananya is tiny in the large establishing panel, so the art will need to make it clear she is the doctor named in the caption. The first balloon's tail ends a little left of the meera box at about (297,940) instead of on it. It should be checked against the final art. No balloon covers a face box. Every grey box carries a dot and a name label, which I took to be a mouth or anchor marker, not a back-of-head dot.
